analysis.summary: This role owns the end-to-end planning workflow and adoption for a store demand forecasting product, focusing on user discovery, workflow integration, and cross-functional execution rather than backend model building. The candidate possesses strong machine learning engineering experience in demand forecasting and model evaluation, but has limited hands-on ownership of product strategy, user discovery, and roadmap prioritization.
